column1: repealed and the following section is substituted therefor: -

column2: 6. (1) Where a cheque bears across its face
an addition of two parallel transverse lines, either
with or without the words “not negotiable”, that
addition constitutes a crossing, and the cheque is
crossed generally.
(2) Where a cheque bears across its face an
addition of the name of a banker, either with or
without the words “not negotiable”, that addition
constitutes a crossing, and the cheque is crossed
specially and to that banker.”.
